commits.headline: feat(rac2): import rac2-gc-decomp master, rebuilt to rac1's structure
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:

games/rac2/ntsc is imported afresh at 99d98838. It now carries the sourcing
edits OpenRAC used to make itself (no include/moby.h, the leaked-material
passages gone), so nothing is excluded or edited here.…

commits.headline: feat(launcher): one main button per game, a tile per game, developer details behind developer tools
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A player's launcher had its main action in a different place and under a
different name on every screen, contributor data (decompilation percentages,
disc serials) on the first page, a command log as a top-level tab, and boxes

- lib/player.svelte.ts answers once what a player can do with a game now.
  The games page shows a tile per game with that one action; a game's page
  shows it as the main button, in a fixed place, with the…

commits.headline: fix(launcher): the figures from openrac.dev are kept under build/, not written into progress/summary.json
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The launcher rewrote the checkout's tracked progress/summary.json with the
website's figures at every start, so running it left the repository modified
(and behind: the site at 4,215 functions over a checkout at 4,290). The copy
for offline starts is now build/launcher/progress.json, and a version shows
the site's figures only where they are ahead of the checkout's.

cargo test and yarn verify pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.headline: feat(editor): pack edited levels back into the game's data, and the port plays them
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
editor/extract.py pack ISO PROJECT OUT turns what was edited in Godot into the
level's gameplay file as the game stores it: for now mobys that were moved,
turned, scaled, given another class or other values. A moby the scene has as
the extractor wrote it keeps its bytes from the disc, so an untouched project
packs to nothing; added and deleted mobys are reported and left out.

editor/wadpack.py is the compressor the format lacked: the inverse of
formats.wad, laid out as the 1,299 retail blocks…

commits.headline: feat(launcher): a Mods page: edit the levels, pack the edits, play with them
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The level editor was a panel on each game's page, and packing had no place.
Mods is a tab of its own with the three steps in order for each game that
can be edited; with developer tools on it also shows the folders and the
commands behind the buttons. actions.json: editor-pack runs the packer, and
play-edited starts the port with --mods.

yarn verify and cargo test pass; the page was checked in the browser preview.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.headline: fix(port): the 2D layer's caller log builds on Windows, through the runtime
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
ui2d.c (the HUD drawn natively, 8a7bae6e) included execinfo.h to name
the callers OPENRAC_UI_LOG lists. Windows has no such header, so the
port did not build there and the launcher's "Build the game" stopped.
ui2d.c cannot include windows.h itself beside the game's headers.

Host code now asks the runtime: openrac_host_caller(depth, text, size)
names the function `depth` calls above its caller, with backtrace on
Linux and macOS and CaptureStackBackTrace on Windows, where the name is
the module…

commits.headline: fix(hostgen): a definition that contradicts an earlier declaration is kept apart
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
rac1/pal's include/callees.h declares 47 engine functions for their
callers, with void * and void where the functions' own C says float *
and int. hostgen's repair for a contradicting declaration looked for the
");" of a declaration; a definition has none, so Clang's error stood and
the whole unit was dropped: src/game/fastfunc.c and src/game/sound.c, 95
functions, on every host. A routine the title calls every frame was
among them, and the game did not get past its title.

The definition gets…

commits.headline: feat(tools): build_port.py hands CMake its own Python and builds extra targets
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A new build folder is configured with -DPython3_EXECUTABLE, the
interpreter the script runs under: CMake's own choice can be an older
Python than hostgen reads (the launcher asks for 3.10 or newer).
--target NAME builds another of the port's targets in the same
environment, for a test program such as runtime_test, which CI runs on
Windows.

Verified on Windows: a folder configured from nothing (the headless
preset, OpenRAC's own rac1/pal) built, and its runtime_test passed; the
14 tests of…

commits.headline: ci(port): build rac1/pal's native program on Windows
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A port-windows job builds openrac-rac1-pal with tools/build_port.py, as
the launcher's "Build the game" does, then runs the runtime's tests and
hostgen's. The port is written on Linux and macOS, and three times in
three days code that only builds there reached master (fseeko, then
execinfo.h twice): this job stops it at the pull request.

Clang is LLVM 21.1.4, fetched from LLVM's release and checked against
its SHA-256, since the runner's own may be older than Visual Studio's
C++ library…

commits.headline: fix(launcher): elapsed time keeps counting, pages never scroll sideways, the window resizes
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
- A running job's time on the Activity page only moved when the page was

  viewport, wider than the page by the scrollbar. The page area now clips
  sideways, and the grids with a fixed least width give way to the window.
- The window can be resized,…

commits.headline: feat(editor): a project per level, mobys named after their class, and what runs each class
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
- godot --split writes a Godot project per level (OUT/level_NN, named after its
  planet). One level imports in about 5 seconds; the 19 in one project take
  about a minute and a half before the editor can be used. pack reads either
  layout.
- A placed moby's node is its class's name and its place in the level's
  table (Vendor_0012, Bolt_0003; Class809_0001 for the unnamed), in place of
  Moby_NNNN. The packer goes by rc1_index, so a renamed node still packs.
- A class scene says what runs…

commits.headline: feat(launcher): the level editor opens one level, chosen on the Mods page
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
An action can be run for a level: run_action takes it, {level} in actions.json
is its two digits (00 while an action is only listed), and the editor's
actions point at the per-level projects in assets/levels/rac1. The Mods page
has a level to choose beside Open the editor; the first time the levels are
extracted (20 seconds) and Godot imports the chosen one itself, in place of
the two-minute import of every level.

cargo test (28) and yarn verify pass. The level picker itself was not seen…
